raw.details:
AlgoSSTrike 

"THINK FAST . CODE FASTER."

Enter the ultimate coding showdown where logic meets speed. Solve challenges, outsmart competitors and put your programming skills to the ultimate test.

Team-based competitive programming contest testing algorithmic skills, coding speed, and teamwork .Compete against top coders, solve challenging problems, and aim to win prizes.

 

Contest Format:

Online Qualifier:

  • Type: Team contest (3 participants per team)
  • Duration: 3 hours
  • Details: Solve a series of algorithmic and data structure problems under a strict time limit; top performers qualify for Offline Finals

Offline Finals:

  • Type: Team contest (3 participants per team) ICPC style Contest
  • Duration: 4 hours
  • Details: Top teams compete offline in a high-pressure environment, showcasing problem-solving ability, speed, and collaboration

Team Composition:

  • Each team consists of 3 participants

Rules & Regulations:

  • Languages Allowed: C, C++, Java, Python
  • Internet Access: Limited to contest platform only; no external assistance allowed
  • Disqualification: Plagiarism, code-sharing, or use of external solutions; multiple registrations prohibited
  • Late Logins: Not permitted
  • Independent Coding: Teams must code independently without external discussions or assistance
  • In Offline Finals : OBS recording setup is mandatory , recording should be done throughout the contest

 

Location:

  • Online Qualifier: Accessible anywhere with an internet connection
  • Offline Finals: Conducted at Scaler School of Technology

Disqualification Criteria:

  • Plagiarism & Code Theft: Unauthorized solution sharing, duplicating logic from other teams, or utilizing external code snippets.
  • External Support: Use of Generative AI (ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.), communication platforms (Discord, Telegram), or any form of outside mentorship.
  • Identity Integrity: Registering via multiple accounts, cross-team participation, or utilizing several handles for a single individual.
  • Procedural Violations: Disregarding proctor directives, tampering with networking/hardware, or breaching venue conduct standards.
  • Teams that fail to produce a valid OBS recording or show evidence of external assistance are disqualified immediately.
